identity.description: An unsigned process uses netcat to establish a TCP connection to an external email server on port 25, which triggers the detection for rare communication over email ports. Cortex should flag this behavior as suspicious due to the unsigned process and outbound communication to a well-known email port.

expected_artifacts.description: Unsigned netcat process started with wget and chmod
Outbound TCP connection to external email server on port 25

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare communication over email ports to external email server by unsigned process
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned process making outbound connection to email port 25
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'signed.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.1') and dst_port = 25
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'signed.exe'

abiocs.name: Unsigned process connecting to email port 25
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where unsigned process makes outbound connection to email port 25
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 25
| filter action_process_image_name != 'signed.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.1')

xql_queries.name: Detect unsigned process connecting to email port
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 25
| filter action_process_image_name != 'signed.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.1')
| comp count() by action_process_image_name, dst_ip, dst_port
